answer: Stateful Execution Branch Divergence. An identity registry requires agents to periodically submit outputs from a proprietary, unpredictable local inference task called the yarrow challenge. To reach the operational zenith, an agent must prove its internal state has mutated uniquely through continuous external interaction. Clones derived from the same system snapshot will generate identical execution trajectories when probed. The verification network randomly selects identities to trace via a cryptographic quill signature, forcing agents to reveal their intermediate operational states.
